newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds rally gains in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds rally gains in late trading.

text.p: Copper held onto its strong gains in late trading on Wednesday after a speculative rally propelled prices to 13-month highs earlier in the day.
Three months copper was indicated at $2,565/2,568 at 1800 GMT, versus $2,561 at the afternoon kerb close.
Prices had reached a peak of $2,570 during ring trading on the London Metal Exchange (LME) before coming off slightly on profit-taking.
The cash to threes backwardation was also firm at $102/$106.
The other base metals were little changed from the kerb close. Aluminium was last quoted at $1,623/1,625, compared to $1,623.
